svg.title: Three-part manifests and comparable operating points
svg.desc: Inventory, run manifest and state timeline join through trial identity and exact output. Constructed A/B comparisons reverse when states are mismatched; matched strata show 10 percent lower latency for B.

g.text: Join hardware identity, run configuration and state evidence
Preserve raw time, outcome and chronology
Constructed comparison: S0 A/B = 10/9 ms; S1 A/B = 20/18 ms.
A/S0 versus B/S1: B looks 80% slower. Balanced: B has 10% lower latency.
Classify comparison fields: matched / intentionally different / unresolved.
Unknown is not zero. A manifest does not prove exclusivity or causation.
